lessonRef.subject: financial-literacy
lessonRef.title: Guided practice: borrowing and paying back

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Financial Literacy elementary sequence — Grade 4
Manuel Academy Financial Literacy G4 Unit 5 — advertising, risk, borrowing, and giving
objective: Learners model an invented borrow-and-repay arrangement, track the balance owed over time, and find when the debt is cleared.
scenario: Rina is an invented fourth grader who borrows $30.00 of simulated money from a pretend club fund and agrees to pay back $6.00 a week. No interest is charged in this arrangement. Everything is invented.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.

tasks.directions: Work out how long Rina's repayment takes at $6.00 a week.

prompts.text: How many whole weeks until Rina has repaid the $30.00?

tasks.directions: Now stop partway through Rina's repayment, at the end of week 3, and work out both what she has paid and what she still owes.

prompts.text: How much has Rina paid back after 3 weeks?
How much does Rina still owe after 3 weeks?

tasks.directions: In week 4 Rina can only pay $2.00 instead of $6.00, then returns to $6.00 a week afterwards.

prompts.text: How much does Rina owe after the short week 4 payment?
How many more whole weeks at $6.00 does it take to clear that?

tasks.directions: One short payment changed the finishing date.

prompts.text: Rina paid less in one week and it added a week to her repayment. What should she tell the club fund, and when?

remediation: When a learner loses track of the balance, keep a two-column ledger for Rina with paid and still owed, and update both columns for every week before answering anything.
extension: Ask the learner what weekly payment would let Rina clear the $30.00 in exactly 4 weeks, and to show the reasoning.
